scope: Overlap independent member/workspace reads after unchanged fresh owner session validation, preserving every authorization check and execution deadline.
riskAnalysis: STRICT shared owner policy. Both fresh records remain mandatory; concurrent failure must never return authority, cache identity or skip revocation checks.

threatModel.assets: App signing key, narrowed token, owner authority, immutable audit and source identity.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Trusted broker/adapter to untrusted provider response; private in-memory receipt to existing Ops failure audit.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged diagnostic fields, raw secret errors, unbounded logging, stalled owner/provider, late completion after timeout or revocation.
threatModel.mitigations: Finite enums, at most 64 bounded events, private WeakMap, frozen terminal receipt, unchanged deadline and guards, abort on exit; no retry.

rollback: Revert only reviewed Preview diagnostic delta; preserve all existing App identity, grants, audit evidence, central revocation, main and Production.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Existing bounded parsers unchanged; diagnostics retain only phase and finite HTTP class.
negativePaths.stale-state: Every existing task/source/release/owner check remains required.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing admission CAS and revocation remain unchanged; diagnostic events cannot grant authority.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing cancel signal plus internal deadline abort stop later boundaries; no already-transmitted request recall claimed.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No new worker or execution route; interrupted audit is terminal and existing cleanup revokes grant.
negativePaths.api-outage: Stalled provider or authorization is bounded by unchanged six seconds; phase remains incomplete rather than fabricated success.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Fresh owner and pending grant guards remain before each boundary; diagnostic code cannot bypass them.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No model calls, repository mutations or spending-ledger changes. The existing exact repository-scoped installation-token POST remains necessary and unchanged.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Late completion cannot mutate sealed diagnostic receipt or complete a revoked invocation.

defects.rootCause: Actual hosted authentication spent4919ms of6s in eight fresh authorizations; independent member/workspace reads were unnecessarily serial.
defects.detectionGap: Prior isolated transport tests did not measure real durable authorization critical-path cost. Finite hosted diagnostics now identify it.
defects.regression: Overlap and per-call freshness; disabled member, foreign ownership/workspace, either storage rejection and invalid session all deny. Existing revoke/CAS/timeout tests retained.
defects.historicalPrevention: Reduced sequential waiting without removing any check; actual hosted completion and savings remain unverified, not guaranteed.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing shared owner review policy, same fresh session followed by concurrent independent member/workspace reads; all validations and downstream task/release/revocation remain unchanged.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Same getSession/getMember/getWorkspace adapters and durable Redis reads; no new API, credential, cache or permission.
proactiveReview.threats: Cross-workspace or repository substitution, forged diagnostics, credential reflection, stale task/release authority, cancellation races and late provider continuation.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Either record rejection denies authority even if sibling read completes later. No atomic snapshot guarantee is added; previous sequential reads were also non-atomic.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Deferred reads prove overlap, second invocation proves fresh reads, disabled/foreign member or owner and either rejected storage read deny; invalid session starts neither read.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA21 and Auditor6 pass actual source; neither claims measured hosted savings. Existing GitHub grant automatically revoked after recorded timeout.
proactiveReview.recovery: Existing interrupted-read CAS revokes the exact grant; no automatic retry, key rotation, permission expansion or authority restoration.
proactiveReview.readiness: Local security checks pass; source-bound STRICT, CI/Redis/CodeQL and new-release hosted attempt remain required. No paid authority.
